slot.brief: Show an alkene structure in a figure; give the ozonolysis product(s) and ask which alkene would produce them.

stem: Reductive ozonolysis with $\text{O}_3$ followed by $\text{Zn}/\text{H}_2\text{O}$ gives the products shown. Which alkene could be the reactant?

verdicts.working: Reductive ozonolysis cleaves the C=C into carbonyls. Propanal comes from an alkene carbon bearing H and ethyl; acetone comes from one bearing two methyl groups. Rejoining gives option A.

working:
Ozonolysis reconnects the two carbonyl carbons to reconstruct the alkene.
Propanone contributes a carbon bearing two methyl groups; propanal contributes a carbon bearing H and ethyl.
Reconstructed alkene: $(\text{CH}_3)_2\text{C}=\text{CHCH}_2\text{CH}_3$.
This is 2-methylpent-2-ene.
